subject: Request to keep pilot live — procurement delay at Medivue
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medivue.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Bennett <liz.bennett@medivue.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keep pilot environment live while PO clears procurement

Hi Irene,

Quick one — our procurement team ran into an approval bottleneck this morning: the PO for the pilot is in final review with finance and legal, but it looks like sign-off will take 4–5 business days. We ran the Redwood trial last week and the product team is mid-internal evaluation; losing access would pause our progress and stakeholder momentum.

Can Redwood keep the pilot environment live for a short period (3–5 days) while the PO completes? We can provide the PO draft and timeline from procurement if that helps.

Appreciate any one-time hold you can provide — this is critical to keep the evaluation moving.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Engineering (Evaluation Lead)
Medivue

Attachment: purchase_order_draft.pdf (stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medivue.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keep pilot environment live while PO clears procurement

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the PO draft. Really glad the team is getting value.

We can provisionally keep the pilot environment active. Two quick asks so we can approve this internally:
- Can procurement share an ETA for PO signature (approx date)?
- Will legal need contract redlines, or is the SOW the same as the mutual action plan we agreed on?

Operationally we can extend the pilot for 72 hours today as an interim measure. If procurement needs more runway, we can approve a one-time 5-business-day keepalive contingent on receiving either the PO or a documented sign-off timeline from procurement/legal.

I attached a short approval stub for your records — this will be logged on our side as a provisional extension. Please reply with the ETA and any outstanding redline items.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot-bridge-approval-20260521.pdf (stub)

From: Liz Bennett <liz.bennett@medivue.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medivue.com>, procurement@medivue.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keep pilot environment live while PO clears procurement

Hi Irene — looping in procurement.

Procurement note: PO is with finance for final budget confirmation; legal flagged two minor contract items (data retention window and liability clause) that may need redlines. We expect an answer from finance by Tuesday, and legal’s comments will be sent the same day.

If Redwood can hold access through Tuesday (5/26), that should give us enough time to get a finalized PO or at least the redlines. If you need a formal confirmation I can ask procurement to send a short timeline email.

Thanks for your flexibility — Sanjay and the product team have been pushing this forward.

Best,
Liz Bennett
Program Manager, Product Operations
Medivue

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Liz Bennett <liz.bennett@medivue.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medivue.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keep pilot environment live while PO clears procurement

Liz / Sanjay — thanks for the quick context and for looping procurement.

We will approve the one-time 5-business-day pilot keepalive, effective immediately. A few operational notes:
- This is a single discretionary extension tied to deal MDV-2026-0421 and contingent on receipt of either the signed PO or a procurement timeline email by the end of the extension window.
- During the extension, usage will be monitored and standard trial quotas apply; if Medivue needs more sustained capacity we should discuss a short paid pilot or reserved capacity.
- Please send any legal redlines to contracts@redwood.com and copy me so our legal ops team can triage.

I'll also attach the provisional approval record (pilot-bridge-approval-20260521.pdf) for your procurement folder. If procurement can prioritize forwarding the PO or the expected signature date, that will help speed the conversion.

If you prefer, Kimberly can set a brief check-in on Wednesday to confirm the PO status.

Thanks — happy to keep the momentum moving.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
